name: Cult of the Black Grail
special_rules: INFECTION MARKERS: Some weapons cause Infection Markers instead of Blood Markers.
Morale: Opponent adds -1 DICE to all Morale Checks (unless Court or Black Grail).
Leader: Must include at least 1 Lord of Tumours or 1 Plague Knight.
If Lord of Tumours taken: up to 2 Plague Knights. If no Lord of Tumours: 1-3 Plague Knights.

abilities: Beelzebub's Touch: When a Melee Attack by this model causes any Blood or Infection Markers to be placed on the target, place 1 extra INFECTION MARKER on the target.
Crushing Blows: Can make a Melee Attack without a weapon. This attack has the CLEAVE 2 keyword.
Undead Fortitude: Add -1 INJURY DICE to Injury Rolls for this model unless the attack has the FIRE keyword.
Undead Fortitude: Add -1 INJURY DICE to Injury Rolls for this model unless the attack has the FIRE keyword.
elites.battlekit_notes: Must have a suit of Armour.
unit_upgrades: Knight Companion (+1 DICE Ranged or Melee)
Knight of the Rotten Cross (1 weapon from NA or HL armoury)

abilities: Bodyguard: Take hit for friendly BLACK GRAIL within 1" (not BLAST).
Parasite Host: When a Melee Attack by this model causes any Blood or Infection Markers to be placed on the target, remove 1 Blood or Infection Marker from this model.
Undead Fortitude: Add -1 INJURY DICE to Injury Rolls for this model unless the attack has the FIRE keyword.
Fly Thrall variant: 6"/Flying instead of 5"/Infantry, gains FLYING keyword. Same cost.
Overwhelming Horde: Can make a Melee Attack without a weapon. Add +1 DICE to the Success Roll for each other friendly Grail/Fly Thrall within 3" of the attacking model.
Undead Fortitude (Grail Thralls only): Add -1 INJURY DICE to Injury Rolls unless the attack has the FIRE keyword. Does not apply to Fly Thralls.
Disease Carrier: Enemy activated within 1" gains Infection Marker.
Frightening Speed: +1 DICE to Risky for Dash.
Teeth & Claws: Can make a Melee Attack without a Melee Weapon.
Undead Fortitude: Add -1 INJURY DICE to Injury Rolls for this model unless the attack has the FIRE keyword.
unit_upgrades: Melee Attacks gain INFECTION MARKERS keyword

abilities: Infected Proboscis: Can make a Melee Attack with the INFECTION MARKERS keyword even without a Melee Weapon. If this attack causes any Infection Markers on the target, remove up to 1 Blood Marker from the Herald.
troops.battlekit_notes: Can only have Ranged Weapons and Compound Eyes Helmet. No other Battlekit.
unit_upgrades: Limit: 1 in warband. Enemy Success Rolls within 8" become Risky.

abilities: Six-armed Monstrosity: Can take 1 Shoot and 1 Fight ACTION per activation with up to 3 weapons each. Can treat two 2-Handed weapons with the HEAVY keyword as 1-Handed.
Corpulent: Add -2 INJURY DICE to Injury Rolls for attacks targeting this model.
Trample ACTION: Melee vs Downed enemy with IGNORE ARMOUR.
Unstoppable: Enemy models on 32mm base or smaller cannot Block a Charge by this model.
troops.battlekit_notes: Can carry up to 6 weapons. Cannot have same weapon more than twice. No Grenades. Can have Shield with Shield Combo. No other Battlekit.
